body.name: F_{\chi}
body.def: If \(\chi\ne\bot\), \(\mathscr A\) certifies \(\chi\) as a rigid chart at \(z\), and its rational expression or selected simple real-algebraic root is evaluable, then \(F_{\chi}(z)\) is that exact value using its twice continuously differentiable local continuation. In every other case, including \(\chi=\bot\) or a nonrigid chart, set \(F_{\chi}(z)=(0,0)\).
body.role: total chartwise PN/PS evaluation with explicit fallback
